name: Angle-pose Cuboid Uniform Initialization (ACUI)
definition: An initialization strategy for X-ray Gaussian Splatting that computes camera parameters from scanner specifications and uniformly samples Gaussian centers within a bounding cuboid, replacing Structure-from-Motion (SfM).
summary: Angle-pose Cuboid Uniform Initialization is a deterministic strategy for X-ray novel view synthesis that replaces Structure-from-Motion by computing camera parameters from scanner specifications and uniformly sampling Gaussian centers within a bounding cuboid.
